Sub: Delegation of role to assign CRO under MLC to Zonal ACCs — Reg.
Madam /Sir,

It has been observed in the recent past that due to the pandemic, cyclone, etc.,
the working of EPF offices mainly in the area of claim settlement has been badly
affected. With the facility of multi-locational settlement of claims, the offices affected
by natural calamities have been able to settle a number of claims through this facility.
It can be said that if this facility is used by the offices properly, it can help
them to disaster proof their respective’ offices to a large extent.

A meeting of few Zonal ACCs was held with CPFC on 9th June, 2021 wherein it
was decided to delegate the role of assigning CRO to DRO under MLC to Zonal ACCs
within their respective jurisdictions without any reference to Head Office. Accordingly,
all Zonal ACCs are hereby informed that they can assign the role of any of the ROs
within their jurisdiction as CRO to any RO (DRO) from their login of MIS Dashboard 2.0
under Multi-location Claim Tab. For example, ACC, Mumbai-I can give the role of CRO
to Dadar for Bandra DRO. Similarly, ACC, Rajasthan who is presently holding the
additional charge of Gujarat Zone can assign the role to Jodhpur as CRO to

Ahmedabad DRO as well as Jaipur DRO as per their respective requirements. However,
if ACC, Kolkata requires CRO(s) from Pune Zone, the request will need to be sent to
Head Office with the concurrence of ACC, Pune.

All the Zonal ACCs are requested to ensure that they should exercise the above
delegation ONLY for DRO - CRO mapping for offices within their respective jurisdiction

The functionality for the same has also been developed by IS Division. Further
details of the same shall be shared by IS Division separately.

It is further informed that the login of the ACCs (by name) on the MIS 2.0 will
have the facility for mapping their DRO with CRO(s). If an ACC has not created his /
her login, the same can be generated by them on their own as per the directions
given on the MIS 2.0 Home Page. Once login is created, OTP based login is not
necessary.

The list of Zonal ACCs with their present charge (including additional charge, if
any) is attached herewith for necessary action by IS Division.

(This issues with the approval of CPFC)

Yours faithfully,

-

(VishaP Agarwal)
Regional PF Commissioner-I (WSU)
